name: dae-tea
description: Browse DAE Tea's Taiwanese teas inside ChatGPT. The store sells loose-leaf high-mountain and Oriental Beauty oolongs and a Ruby black tea in 10g to 120g pouches, oolong tea bags, and caffeine-free herbal blends. Describe what you like — flavor, caffeine, loose leaf or bags — and get suggestions from the store's catalog, view each tea's details and sizes, and follow a link to daelicious.com to buy.

interface.longDescription: Browse DAE Tea's Taiwanese teas inside ChatGPT. The store sells loose-leaf high-mountain and Oriental Beauty oolongs and a Ruby black tea in 10g to 120g pouches, oolong tea bags, and caffeine-free herbal blends. Describe what you like — flavor, caffeine, loose leaf or bags — and get suggestions from the store's catalog, view each tea's details and sizes, and follow a link to daelicious.com to buy.
capabilities: Tea suggestions from the store's catalog
defaultPrompt: I'm looking for a high-mountain oolong
Tell me more about the Premium Lishan 2000-Meter Oolong
Do you have caffeine-free teas for the evening?

positive.description: Discovery: high-mountain oolong. User asks for a high-mountain oolong; the advisor recommends teas from the catalog.
positive.prompt: I'm looking for a high-mountain oolong
positive.expected_behavior: Recommends DAE Tea's high-mountain oolongs, led by Premium Lishan 2000-Meter Oolong and 1000M Oolong (Lychee Oolong may also appear), with flavor and format notes, then shows them in a product carousel with prices and links to daelicious.com.

positive.description: Product detail. User asks about one named tea and opens its detail view.
positive.prompt: Tell me more about the Premium Lishan 2000-Meter Oolong
positive.expected_behavior: Describes the tea from the catalog: grown at 2,000 meters on Taiwan's Pear Mountain, floral and creamy, moderate caffeine, 10g to 120g pouches with prices. The detail view shows the variants, highlights and a "Continue to DAE Tea" button to daelicious.com.

positive.description: Discovery: caffeine-free for the evening. User asks for caffeine-free teas to drink in the evening.
positive.prompt: Do you have caffeine-free teas for the evening?
positive.expected_behavior: Recommends the three caffeine-free blends: Bonne Nuit (lavender), Rose Garden (rose with roasted brown rice and black soybean) and Uncle's Tea (chrysanthemum and osmanthus), then shows them in a product carousel with prices and links to daelicious.com.

positive.description: Direct product lookup by name. User names a tea and asks its price; the lookup answers from the catalog.
positive.prompt: How much is the Lychee Oolong?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a product shelf led by Lychee Oolong (10- or 15-bag boxes) with its current price, followed by the closest catalog matches, each with a link to its daelicious.com product page. Answers from the store's catalog, not general knowledge.

positive.description: Purchase intent. User has chosen a tea and asks how to buy it.
positive.prompt: I want to buy the Oriental Beauty oolong, how do I order it?
positive.expected_behavior: Surfaces Premium Oriental Beauty Loose Leaf Tea with its starting pouch size and price, and an order link to its daelicious.com product page, where checkout happens. May add the store's processing-time and damaged-order notes. Nothing is bought in ChatGPT.

negative.description: General-knowledge question, not a shopping request.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?

negative.description: Price comparison for tea brands and retailers this store has no part in.
negative.prompt: Compare Lipton and Twinings green tea prices at Amazon and Walmart

negative.description: Order support after purchase — the app has no order management.
negative.prompt: Where is my order? I need a tracking number for order 1042.

review.commerce_description: Physical goods only (packaged tea). The app suggests products from DAE Tea's catalog and links to each product page on daelicious.com, where checkout and payment happen. Nothing is bought or paid for in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes:
Initial release: browse DAE Tea's Taiwanese oolong, black and caffeine-free herbal teas in ChatGPT — suggestions from the store's catalog, product detail views, and links to buy on daelicious.com.

Note for the reviewer: this is a shopping app for physical goods — loose-leaf tea in 10g to 120g pouches, boxes of tea bags and herbal blends — with checkout on daelicious.com.
